head: smḥ (< Arab. smḥ cf. Wehr 596: erlauben, gestatten; < Arab. smḥ (II) cf. Wehr 596: mit Güte handeln;)

examples.turoyo: iḏa kān k-səmḥat, d-obat-li ṭaṣe d-maye m-i=dguštayḏax
examples.translation: wenn du erlaubst, gibst du mir eine Schale Wasser aus deinem Krug
examples.raw: iḏa kān k-səmḥat, d-obat-li ṭaṣe d-maye m-i=dguštayḏax ʻwenn du erlaubst, gibst du mir eine Schale Wasser aus deinem Krugʼ; 215; 53/64;

examples.turoyo: k-obaʕno d-aloho msamaḥ-li, w-ono gəd-howéno-le greʕo hul l-u=mawto
examples.translation: I want God to forgive me and I will become [His] servant till the very death
examples.raw: k-obaʕno d-aloho msamaḥ-li, w-ono gəd-howéno-le greʕo hul l-u=mawto ʻI want God to forgive me and I will become [His] servant till the very deathʼ; 215; 43/42;

examples.turoyo: uʕdo ʕféli-lux w-k-obaʕno d-msamḥat-li b-i=ġalṭ-aṯi diḏi
examples.translation: Now, I have forgiven you and I want you to pardon me for my fault
examples.raw: uʕdo ʕféli-lux w-k-obaʕno d-msamḥat-li b-i=ġalṭ-aṯi diḏi ‘Now, I have forgiven you and I want you to pardon me for my fault’; 36/138;

examples.translation: I forgive you, but I will not stay with you anymore
examples.raw: ono k-msamaḥn-ux, bas gabux lə=k-foyašno ‘I forgive you, but I will not stay with you anymore’; 36/143;

examples.translation: Now I come to you that we may pardon each other
examples.raw: gəd-oṯeno uʕdo l-gabux d-msamḥina ḥḏoḏe ‘Now I come to you that we may pardon each other’; 42/10;

examples.turoyo: omər ya malk-ayḏi k-obaʕno mede minux gə-msamḥət-li ebe
examples.translation: My king, I want something from you. Will you grant it to me?
examples.raw: omər ya malk-ayḏi k-obaʕno mede minux gə-msamḥət-li ebe ‘My king, I want something from you. Will you grant it to me?’ 84/46;
